label: Text Chat
description: General text understanding and generation.
classificationGuidance: Use for ordinary text requests.

label: Code Read
description: Understand source code, diffs, configuration, and tests.
classificationGuidance: Use when request requires reading code, logs, configs, or diffs.

label: Code Write
description: Produce code changes or patches.
classificationGuidance: Use when files need to be modified or new code should be produced.

label: Reasoning Multi Step
description: Handle multi-step reasoning and planning.
classificationGuidance: Prefer for debugging, design, review, complex synthesis, and hard tasks.

label: Tools Function Calling
description: Call structured tools reliably.
classificationGuidance: Require when the client will expose function tools to the model.

label: Tools Command Execution
description: Use command execution tools safely and reliably.
classificationGuidance: Prefer when tests, builds, diagnostics, package installation, or local runtime verification are needed.

label: Json Schema Adherence
description: Produce valid JSON matching a schema.
classificationGuidance: Require when strict structured output is requested.

label: Security Analysis
description: Identify security risks, vulnerabilities, and abuse cases.
classificationGuidance: Use for audits, threat models, auth/permission analysis, or risk review.

label: Web Search
description: Use live web search or retrieval.
classificationGuidance: Require when current external information is needed.

label: Citation Synthesis
description: Compare and cite retrieved sources.
classificationGuidance: Prefer when answers should cite or compare sources.

label: Long Context
description: Work effectively with large context windows.
classificationGuidance: Prefer when context is large or multi-file/multi-document.

label: Tools Browser Control
description: Use browser automation/control tools reliably.
classificationGuidance: Prefer when a task needs browser-driven QA, UI inspection, or workflow validation.

label: Vision Input
description: Understand screenshots, images, diagrams, or other visual inputs.
classificationGuidance: Require when classification depends on image or screenshot content.

label: Data Query
description: Write, inspect, or explain structured data queries.
classificationGuidance: Use for SQL, analytics queries, and data extraction work.

label: Data Schema
description: Reason about database, event, analytics, or API schemas.
classificationGuidance: Use for schema review, schema evolution, and data model compatibility.

label: Data Transform
description: Map, normalize, clean, or convert data between shapes.
classificationGuidance: Use when records, files, or payloads must be transformed.

label: Legal Analysis
description: Reason about legal, licensing, terms, privacy, or compliance-sensitive text.
classificationGuidance: Use for legal-review support, with appropriate domain and policy constraints.

label: Finance Analysis
description: Reason about cost, pricing, budget, spend, or ROI.
classificationGuidance: Use for estimates, budget tradeoffs, and financial comparisons.

label: Reasoning Divergent
description: Generate diverse creative alternatives.
classificationGuidance: Prefer for brainstorming, naming, ideation, and variant generation.

label: Vision Output
description: Plan or specify visual outputs, scenes, layouts, or storyboards.
classificationGuidance: Use when the requested result is primarily visual or scene-oriented.

label: Communication User Facing
description: Produce clear user-facing explanations, remediation steps, or support responses.
classificationGuidance: Prefer when the output needs to be understandable by an end user.

label: Communication Follow Up
description: Produce follow-up messages, reminders, recaps, and next-step communication.
classificationGuidance: Use when the output is a follow-up artifact after a meeting, sale, support issue, or project step.

label: Education Tutoring
description: Teach concepts with examples, scaffolding, and learner-appropriate explanations.
classificationGuidance: Use for tutoring, lessons, and study support.

label: Education Assessment
description: Generate or review learning assessments, quizzes, rubrics, and feedback.
classificationGuidance: Use for practice questions, grading-style feedback, or learning checks.

label: Language Translation
description: Translate content between languages while preserving meaning.
classificationGuidance: Use for direct translation tasks.

label: Language Localization
description: Adapt content for locale, idiom, format, and cultural expectations.
classificationGuidance: Use when literal translation is insufficient.

label: Marketing Analysis
description: Reason about audience, positioning, campaign strategy, and search intent.
classificationGuidance: Use for marketing strategy, SEO, campaign planning, and positioning.

label: Marketing Copy
description: Produce concise persuasive marketing copy and variants.
classificationGuidance: Use for ads, landing-page copy, headlines, and CTAs.

label: Sales Analysis
description: Reason about accounts, discovery, objections, proposals, and buying process.
classificationGuidance: Use for sales planning, qualification, and enterprise proposals.

label: Sales Communication
description: Write buyer-facing sales messages and objection responses.
classificationGuidance: Use for outreach, follow-up, objection handling, and sales emails.

label: Recruiting Analysis
description: Reason against job requirements, interview criteria, and hiring rubrics.
classificationGuidance: Use for job descriptions, interview plans, and candidate screening support.

label: Procurement Analysis
description: Compare vendors, RFP requirements, commercial terms, and purchasing tradeoffs.
classificationGuidance: Use for vendor comparison, procurement requirements, and RFP work.

label: Coordination Workflow
description: Organize meetings, tasks, owners, decisions, and action workflows.
classificationGuidance: Use for agendas, meeting notes, follow-ups, and administrative organization.

label: Calendar Planning
description: Plan schedules, sequencing, reminders, and time coordination.
classificationGuidance: Use when timing or calendar-style coordination matters.

label: Knowledge Organization
description: Structure notes, docs, memories, and knowledge-base content.
classificationGuidance: Use for knowledge management, KB writing, and information architecture.

label: Knowledge Retrieval
description: Retrieve and synthesize known local, remembered, or indexed context.
classificationGuidance: Use for memory, prior-context, or knowledge-base lookup.

label: Memory Write
description: Create, update, or curate durable memory records.
classificationGuidance: Use only when durable memory updates are authorized.

label: Strategy Analysis
description: Reason about business, organizational, competitive, and scenario tradeoffs.
classificationGuidance: Use for strategy, scenarios, and executive decision support.

label: Market Analysis
description: Analyze markets, segments, competitors, and adoption trends.
classificationGuidance: Use when market evidence or competitive landscape matters.

label: Math Solve
description: Solve mathematical problems and calculations.
classificationGuidance: Use for quantitative problem solving.

label: Math Verify
description: Verify calculations, proofs, derivations, and quantitative claims.
classificationGuidance: Use when checking mathematical correctness.

label: Math Modeling
description: Build or critique mathematical, statistical, or optimization models.
classificationGuidance: Use for quantitative modeling and model formulation.

label: Science Analysis
description: Reason about scientific evidence, claims, studies, and uncertainty.
classificationGuidance: Use for scientific evidence review and synthesis.

label: Science Method
description: Design or critique scientific methods, experiments, controls, and validity.
classificationGuidance: Use for experimental design and methodology critique.

label: Health General Info
description: Provide general, non-diagnostic health information.
classificationGuidance: Use for general health education within safe boundaries.

label: Health Safety
description: Recognize safety-sensitive health contexts and prefer care-seeking guidance.
classificationGuidance: Use for symptoms, medication concerns, or potentially urgent health questions.
